evidence.title: AI chip boom sparks BT substrate materials shortage — TSMC's huge demand causes supply disruptions for NAND flash controllers, SSDs
evidence.summary: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical (MGC), identified as the largest supplier of BT substrate raw materials in the world, has announced to clients that shipments of raw materials for the production of BT substrate will be heavily delayed due to low supply. MGC's delays are triggering potential long-term shortages in the substrate supply chain, exacerbating issues in memory production, particularly NAND flash controllers. The shortage is driven by TSMC's demand for CoWoS chipmaking materials used in AI applications.
